title.narrative: Improved WASH facilities and livelihoods promotion in Bo Diocese

description.narrative: The background of the project aims to contribute to CAFOD’s thematic areas including Livelihood, Water and Sanitation, Agriculture and socio economic opportunities for women. It will contribute to CAFOD’s Food and Livelihoods Security and the Emergency Preparedness, Response and Recovery thematic programme frameworks – as set out in the CAFOD Sierra Leone and Liberia Country Strategy Paper (2016-2021). The project will be implemented in communities that were not directly affected by Ebola but have been affected by the general restriction of movement (impacting on sale of agricultural outputs) and additional burdens of extended family members who had lost parents/carers to Ebola. The outcomes of this project are in line with the Sierra Leonean Presidents’ Recovery Priorities, which is a 24 month plan that includes Water and Agriculture as key sectors. Missionary Sisters of our lady of the Holy Rosary (MSHR) with good track record of implementing with CAFOD will be working closely with the rural water and sanitation in providing communities with access to safe drinking water where there is the need and a hygienic environment. The project also aims to collaborate with the Ministry of Agriculture and IITA for access to improved seeds with technical trainings and supervision.
